answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 2 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the lantern reference is updated at each spiral checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the saffron audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot burn for 189 aliases however many keys the operator holds. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
